collision: cosmic-formal being vs mundane annoyance; blood-literalism; wrong-expert (sues instead of bites)

beats.label: deadpan
beats.text: I am Dracula. I flew three hundred miles for this audition. The coach was unacceptable.

beats.label: deadpan
beats.text: They offered me a garlic bread basket. GARLIC. On an aircraft. In this economy of blood.

beats.label: deadpan
beats.text: My reflection has not attended one of my events in four hundred years. No RSVP. No card.
